claims.evidence: The R2026b release notes say MATLAB no longer includes Java Runtime as part of its installation. Users must install OpenJDK separately, for example through the MATLAB Support for OpenJDK add-on.
claims.sourceQuote: Starting in R2026b, MATLAB no longer includes Java as part of its installation.
claims.sourcesSay: Starting in R2026b, MATLAB no longer bundles a Java Runtime, and users must install OpenJDK separately if they need Java.
claims.corrected: Installing MATLAB no longer installs its own bundled Java Runtime Environment, so you need to install Java (such as OpenJDK) separately.
claims.note: The newer release notes directly reverse the claim that a JRE is bundled.
